items.title: Why Brown Forman Stock And Other Defensive Dividend Names Matter Now
items.summary: Recession chatter is getting louder as the Fed debates more rate hikes, yet dividend payers with strong balance sheets are still throwing off cash and, in some cases, holding up better than racier growth stories. Income-focused investors do not need to sit on the sidelines. This article walks through three large US dividend stocks from our screener that appear especially exposed to the latest policy shock, and explains why that matters for your portfolio. items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $400,000 portfolio split evenly across Comcast, Hormel Foods and AT&T pays about $20,500 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $1,710 a month.
